audit.whatIsWrong: The audit never mentions that Twisted Advance (W) makes Maokai untargetable during the dash, so all-in cooldowns thrown mid-dash are wasted, nor that Nature's Grasp (R) creates terrain that can wall off Karma's retreat since she has no dash of her own.
audit.why: Both are in missingInteractions and are decisive: untargetable-dodges-burst changes how you should spend cooldowns on his W engage, and terrain-cuts-retreat is a threat specific to Karma because she lacks a gap-closer/blink to escape the wall.
audit.corrected: Added to dosFull[2].d (wait out the untargetable window) and a new dontsFull note plus breakdown.cooldowns covering R's terrain-block threat to her escape.
